episodes.synopsis: Kabamaru, a ninja boy from the mountain village of Iga, arrives in Tokyo and turns heads with his earnest yet hilarious ways.
episodes.title: Enter the Funny-Yet-Serious Ninja!

episodes.synopsis: Kabamaru unexpectedly finds himself the most popular kid at his new school, Kingyoku Academy.
episodes.title: Unexpectedly Popular?!

episodes.synopsis: Bursting with energy and his bottomless love of yakisoba, Kabamaru throws himself into a new challenge with everything he's got.
episodes.title: Give It Your All! Yakisoba D

episodes.synopsis: Tender feelings start to bloom between Kabamaru and Mai amid an awkward, comical mix-up.
episodes.title: Sweet Mai… Excuse Me, Kabamaru!

episodes.synopsis: An unexpected discovery leads Kabamaru into a fresh confrontation and adventure.
episodes.title: The Mejiro Discovery Chronicle

episodes.synopsis: Kabamaru's worries spiral into a playful game of disguises and transformations.
episodes.title: Troubled Minds and the Transformation Game

episodes.synopsis: Between endless running and his love of yakisoba, Kabamaru tastes the loneliness of the long-distance runner.
episodes.title: The Loneliness of the Yakisoba Runner

episodes.synopsis: A side story returns to the ninja village of Iga, reuniting Kabamaru with his comrade Hayate.
episodes.title: Side Story! The Two from the Ninja Village

episodes.synopsis: Kaoru the kunoichi shows up to dazzle everyone with her skills and charm.
episodes.title: Dazzling! Kaoru the Kunoichi

episodes.synopsis: On a holy night, the threads of love tangle like a scattered jigsaw waiting to be pieced together.
episodes.title: Jigsaw Love on a Holy Night

episodes.synopsis: A closely guarded ninja secret — an elixir that brings the dead back to life — sets off a string of bizarre situations.
episodes.title: Secret Art! The Resurrection Elixir

episodes.synopsis: Pranks and surprises pile up when someone takes on the role of a stern guardman.
episodes.title: Surprise! The Guardman

episodes.synopsis: A comic bedroom mix-up turns the whole night upside down.
episodes.title: Don't Hold Me in Bed

episodes.synopsis: A romantic encounter under the starlight brings two hearts unexpectedly closer.
episodes.title: Starlight Encounter

episodes.synopsis: Grueling athletic training and contests take the gang back to their roots in Iga.
episodes.title: Athletic in Iga

episodes.synopsis: In the ninja village of Iga, the bond of brotherhood between Kabamaru and Hayate is put to the test.
episodes.title: Brotherhood Code of the Ninja Village

episodes.synopsis: Kabamaru is gripped by confused feelings for Mai and can't figure out how to confess.
episodes.title: Troubled… Mai… Love

episodes.synopsis: A storm blows in along with a loud newcomer who turns everything upside down.
episodes.title: The Man Who Summons Storms!

episodes.synopsis: Mai plays detective in a mysterious yet comical case.
episodes.title: Mai's Detective Story

episodes.synopsis: A charming secret comes to light about the first loves of Madam Ran and Madam Su.
episodes.title: Secret! The First Loves of Ran & Su

episodes.synopsis: A secret ninja technique and a strange mystery wrap around a baseball game with a yakisoba flavor.
episodes.title: Secret Technique! The Yakisoba Baseball Mystery

episodes.synopsis: Mai is kidnapped in the middle of a raging storm, and Kabamaru races to the rescue.
episodes.title: Stormy Mai-jack

episodes.synopsis: In the night fog, a decisive showdown unfolds as the men settle their scores with honor.
episodes.title: Showdown in the Night Fog! A Man's Resolve

episodes.synopsis: The hour of farewell arrives, bringing Kabamaru's adventure to a moving close.
episodes.title: What You Might Call a Goodbye Day
